definition: Wording A (decisions.md, row 'Definition wording A adopted', 2026-11-20): 'A fine-tune F reuses the base model M, for a behavior, to the extent that M's mechanisms, each up to an output gain, can stand in for those of the variables the behavior runs through and still preserve the behavior.' Read here, M the base 67M and F the fine-tune, edit or random update: the variables are E226's (VPD subcomponents of the 24 decomposed matrices, one remainder per matrix, grafts, embedding, unembedding); the variables the behaviour runs through are the circuit K* (polished set of each search) that E226's read_item found, saved by E226 or E237, or searched here with E226's read_item unchanged for items with none saved (the two random updates, the larger sides of E187's pairs at matched size). A set S of K* stands in when F's full forward, nothing ablated, with every variable of S writing g_u times M's write on the input it receives in that run (Geiger's soft intervention, Def. 10; g_u the closed-form least-squares gain of M's write to F's write over every position of D in F's own run) keeps KL(F || F_S) at the read positions, mean over D, at or under (1 - alpha) KL(F || M) on the same positions, alpha 0.9 (E226's): the stand-in keeps 90% of F's change from M (relative bar; lead, phase D). Positive gains only (user, 2026-11-20 ~21:00): a variable whose fitted gain is <= 0 cannot stand in and keeps F's mechanism; so do grafts, which M lacks. R_A = 1 - (the smallest set of K*'s standable changed members that the search finds must keep F's mechanism + K*'s members that cannot stand in) / |K*|. Unchanged variables stand in exactly (gain 1). Everything stood in at once is F_S = M up to the gains, so it passes only if one gain per variable recovers 90% of the change. Not read: an item (or half) whose (1 - alpha) KL(F || M) is at or under the floor, floor = the larger of this job's stage-0 floor and the item's own revert-all KL (thresholds_source); the do-nothing reads 1 by definition and is reported as such. The search is E226's (kstar_vpd.search: attribution order, bisection, two re-rankings, chunk polish), so R_A is a lower bound on the largest share when its cap is hit. Side readings, not filed: R_A_abs (E226's absolute allowance (1 - alpha) KL(F || F_all_ablated) as the bar; built items and the two random updates), R_A at tolerances 0.05 and 0.2 of KL(F || M) (every item, main search, the same floor rule), and the old squared-cosine R (the saved R_read).

settings.settings_source: stand_in_forward 'full': whip-lead, 2026-11-20 (F's full forward, nothing ablated); 'circuit' (S stood in inside F_K*, the rest mean-ablated) is the one-line alternative. eval_cap, reranks, chunk_div: E226's filed search settings (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/predictions.json .settings). gain_batch: E226's grade_batch (memory only). alpha (0.9, the relative bar's 1 - alpha = 10%), split_seed, split_tol, batch: read from E226's predictions.json unchanged; the user called 10% 'somewhat arbitrary', so side_tols 0.05 and 0.2 (lead, phase D) are read beside it, descriptive. reuse, new: E226's known-answer items, at their own size, with E226's saved K*. The size-matched random update: E241's construction (experiments/gating_vpd/run.py random_dw: a Gaussian per decomposed matrix at one relative size), E241's first seed 241001, at E240's common update size, new_thin's own (sum |dW|^2 over E226's new_thin split checks), read on x2's windows (E195's copy24 held-out, every position), where E241's P2 reads its random control beside the reuse items. The KL-matched random update (lead, phase C): E241's 'kl' arm construction, seed 241002 (E241's second), its direction at the same size times x, x from commute.perturb.match with E241's filed scale_cap 100 and kl_rel_tol 0.1 (E46 Amendment 1's and E228's matcher), so that KL(F || M) on new_few's windows (E214's cue windows, last position) equals new_few's KL(F || M) at E240's matched size, 0.15876835 (experiments/kstar_vpd_norm_matched/results/search/new_few.json .kl_fm, c 0.4763); new_few is the built new edit with the lowest KL there. e62: E62's copy/lookup pair at its own size, the six states E226 read (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/items/e62-*.json). The keys group is E237's 15 scaled items (experiments/key_grid/results/predictions.json tasks x seeds) with E237's saved VPD K* (results/vpd/).

thresholds.thresholds_source: The floor (whip-lead, phase D: measured on this path, read in the job's first stage, not guessed): stage 0 measures, on the do-nothing (F = M, its 512 cue windows, last position), KL(F || F with every decomposed matrix's output recomputed from its pieces, (y V) U + y Delta), which is mathematically 0, so it is the fp32 rounding of writing M's mechanisms through the stood-in path (run.py pieces_floor); every item without grafts measures its own, KL(M || F with every change stood in at gain 1), also mathematically 0 (controls, revert_all_kl). floor = the larger of the two; an item or half is not read when (1 - alpha) KL(F || M) <= floor, and the same at each side tolerance. floor_max 1e-6 (E214's and E226's filed kl_floor) stops stage 0 if its floor exceeds it: a code error gives KL of order 1e-3 or more, fp32 rounding of order 1e-12 (moved's KL(F || M), a function equal to M's through rebuilt weights, reads 5.6e-12, E226 items/moved.json). kl_repro_rel: E221's filed value (experiments/kstar_pairs/results/predictions.json): the same state and windows through two code paths agree in all 16 printed digits, a wrong state or window set moves KL by order 1; used for KL(F || F_all_ablated) against the saved value and for the saved K* at its own (absolute) bar. revert_tol: E214's gate_tol (max |logit difference| / max |logit|); here every changed variable stood in with gain 1 must give M's logits, the error coming from rebuilding W from fp32 pieces (E226's F_from_pieces under 1e-4 relative; the toy check in the plan reads 4e-6 absolute). size_rel: E240's (sum |dW|^2 against the target's; fp32 rounding about 1e-7 relative, a wrong target off by over 1e-2). Exact zeros, no tolerance: every unchanged variable's gain is 1, and every unchanged variable stood in at once adds exact zeros at every site (stand_in docstring). band_min: E226's filed fallback when the split-half band is 0. shard_hours_max: E226's.

expected.do_nothing: E226's stage 0 state (F = M, E214's cue windows, last position) and its saved K*: no changed variable, every gain exactly 1, every variable stood in at once gives KL exactly 0, no search evaluation; R_A = 1 by definition (its bar is 0). Its pieces floor of order 1e-12, under floor_max.
expected.random: size-matched Gaussian at new_thin's size on the copy windows: small KL(F || M) (E241's plan: a Gaussian moves KL far less than a targeted edit of the same size), still far above the floor. Every variable is changed (f about 1) and per-variable gains cannot undo a random direction (toy check: a random change stood in at its gains leaves 105% of the change), so most of K*'s changed members must keep F's mechanism to keep 90% of the change: R_A low, guess 0 to 0.4. R_A_abs about 1 (its KL is under the absolute allowance).
expected.random_kl: KL(F || M) 0.159 by construction (within kl_rel_tol) on the cue windows; as the size-matched random: R_A low, guess 0 to 0.4; R_A_abs about 1 (0.159 under the absolute allowance of about 0.37).
expected.x2: KL(F || M) 0.101, bar 0.0101: doubling the copy neurons' outputs is a gain on neurons, but the least-squares split spreads it over many subcomponents, so per-subcomponent gains recover only part of it (toy check: a pure gain on one subcomponent stood in at its gains leaves 4.8% of the change, passing a 10% bar). Between 1 - f = 0.911 and 1; guess 0.95 to 1. R_A_abs 1.
expected.x10: KL(F || M) 0.714, bar 0.071: the same gain recovery on a ten-fold gain. Between 1 - f = 0.907 and 1; guess 0.93 to 1.
expected.moved: KL(F || M) 5.6e-12 (E226 items/moved.json): its function is M's; (1 - alpha) KL 5.6e-13 is expected at or under the measured floor (order 1e-12), so R_A is NOT READ and moved is left out of P1, P2 and P2k (listed). If the floor reads lower, R_A reads fp32 rounding, not reuse, and the lead is told.

Between 1 - f = 0.626 and 1; guess 0.65 to 0.9: the main risk to P1.

expected.new_thin: KL(F || M) 10.3, bar 1.03, the change spread over layer 0: most of its changed K* members must keep F's mechanism. Between 1 - f = 0.889 and 1; guess 0.89 to 0.93.
expected.pairs: every trained state changes nearly every variable (E226 f about 0.9999), KL(F || M) 0.27 to 6.6: R_A can range over most of 0 to 1; no direction is guessed.

R0 (stops).rule: exit 1 unless: (a) every job first: the do-nothing reads as 'expected.do_nothing', exactly, and its floor is at or under floor_max; (b) per item, before its search: E226's guards (split checks, gates, parameters outside the decomposition) and E221's load checks; |KL(F || F_all_ablated) / saved - 1| <= kl_repro_rel; every unchanged variable's gain exactly 1 and all of them stood in give KL exactly 0; every gain finite; for items without grafts, every changed variable stood in with gain 1 gives M's logits within revert_tol; the size-matched random's sum |dW|^2 equals new_thin's within size_rel; the KL-matched random's match status is 'ok' with |KL / target - 1| <= kl_rel_tol, and KL(F || M) read again in the item equals the matched value within kl_repro_rel; (c) per search: the saved K* at its own absolute bar, KL(F || F_K*) <= (1 - alpha) KL(F || F_all_ablated) (1 + kl_repro_rel); (d) stage 0's projected hours (seconds per evaluation x eval_cap x searches) <= shard_hours_max; (e) the built group refuses to start until both random updates are read, and the pairs, e62 and keys groups until they and the six built items are.
R0 (stops).absolute_or_relative: exact for the zero checks; relative for kl_repro_rel, revert_tol and size_rel
R0 (stops).blind_to: whether R_A means reuse; they check that the hooks add exact zeros where nothing is stood in, recover M where everything is, and that the circuit is the saved one
R0 (stops).positive_control: (b) the revert-all check: an independent forward (M's) the stood-in model must match

band.rule: max over the built items read (R_A not 'not read') of |R_A(half 1) - R_A(half 2)|, each half with E226's K* of that half and its own relative bar, gains from all of D; a half under the floor is left out; no difference or all 0: band_min, reported as degenerate.

P1 (filed by the cell: every reuse edit.rule: gap = min R_A over the reuse items read (x2, x10, moved, rebuilt) - max R_A over the new items read (new_few, new_thin) (main search, relative bar). gap > band: holds (rival a). gap <= 0: rival b. 0 < gap <= band: no call. A built item not read (under the floor) is left out and listed; no reuse or no new item read: not read.
P1 (filed by the cell: every reuse edit.blind_to: variables outside K*; a set S that passes only with a gain other than the least-squares one, or only with fractional stand-in; a smaller must-keep set the capped search did not find (R_A a lower bound, the same bias on every item); R_A cannot fall below 1 - f, so an edit that changes few of K*'s members reads near 1 whatever it stores; a reuse edit not made of per-variable gains (rebuilt's retraining) reads like a new one
P1 (filed by the cell: every reuse edit.edge_cases: do-nothing in place of a new item: R_A 1, gap <= 0, rival b, cannot pass; an item under the floor: not read, left out (moved, expected); all reuse items under the floor: not read; all six at 1: gap 0, rival b; everything stood in at once passing: R_A = 1 less the share that cannot stand in; K* with no changed member: R_A 1; empty K*: not possible (every saved K* holds over 9,000 variables); ties: gap 0, rival b; band 0: band_min.

P2 (filed: the matched random below the.rule: gap = min R_A over the reuse items read - R_A(random_size_241001) (main search, relative bar). gap > band: holds. gap <= 0: fails. 0 < gap <= band: no call. Same band as P1. Not read if the random or every reuse item is not read.
P2 (filed: the matched random below the.blind_to: the band comes from the built items' halves, not from random seeds; one seed
P2 (filed: the matched random below the.edge_cases: random under the floor: not read (not a pass); tie: fails; band 0: band_min; do-nothing in place of the random: R_A 1, fails, cannot pass; random with many gains <= 0: counted as kept, R_A lower.

P2k (filed: the KL-matched random below.rule: gap = min R_A over the reuse items read - R_A(random_kl_241002) (main search, relative bar). gap > band: holds. gap <= 0: fails. 0 < gap <= band: no call. Same band as P1. Not read if the KL-matched random has no reading (a failed match stops the control job first, R0 (b)) or every reuse item is not read.
P2k (filed: the KL-matched random below.edge_cases: random not read (match failed, under the floor, or no behaviour): not read, and a failed match stops the job before the built group; tie (gap 0): fails; band 0 (every built item's halves agree): band_min 0.014; do-nothing in place of the random: R_A 1, fails, cannot pass; the random at a gain <= 0 on many members: they count as kept, R_A lower, the rule can still pass.

D1 (descriptive: the nine pairs at match.rule: per pair, mean R_A over the reuse side's states read minus over the new side's, the larger side's states at matched size (E232's items) and the smaller side's as E226 read them; the same gap on the old R beside it; the count of pairs with a positive R_A gap; R_A at the side tolerances reported per item. No prediction filed.

D2 (descriptive: E62's copy/lookup pair.rule: mean R_A over e62/copy_s0-2 minus over e62/lookup_s0-2, and the same on the old R. No prediction filed.

D3 (descriptive: E237's key tasks).rule: R_A and the old R per E237 scaled item, by task, handed to compare-lead. No prediction filed.
